verified.exploit_entry_point: HTTP GET /api/icon/getDynamicIcon with type=8 (unauthenticated), driven in-process with httptest against the real gin handler. This control covers only the advisory's own route.
routes: T2: GET /api/icon/getDynamicIcon?type=8 with markup in the text value
verified.project_tests_run: go test -vet=off -run '^$' ./api/ ./server/ ./util/ ./model/ (the pinned project has no behavioural tests for these packages)
